name: xAI Grok API
tagline: xAI Grok models for chat, tools, and image generation via a REST API
description: xAI Grok API exposes Grok language and multimodal models for chat completions, tool calling, structured outputs, and image generation. Developers authenticate with API keys and call HTTPS endpoints under api.x.ai. The API is OpenAI-compatible for many chat paths, with xAI-specific models and features documented on docs.x.ai.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header. Create keys in the xAI Console (console.x.ai). Self-serve signup.

use_cases: chat with Grok models for reasoning and coding help
call tools / function calling from an agent
generate images with Grok image models
run OpenAI-compatible chat completions against Grok
stream long model responses for interactive apps
